title: Regional Font Alternatives
slide_intent: Preserve a comparable voice across writing systems because language coverage should not force every market into a different visual personality.
strategic_value: The Chinese headline, subhead and body examples can extend Burger King’s hierarchy beyond Flame’s supported characters.
demonstration: Three Chinese text samples are paired with named Fang Zheng alternatives and a note about obtaining approval.
practical_value: Use the Chinese examples as a model for proposing a stylistically related local alternative when Flame lacks language support.

content_islands.name: Selection and approval guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the explanatory column at left and the Chinese-example label below.

content_islands.name: Regional specimens
content_islands.spec: Stack the three font names and corresponding Chinese examples by headline, subhead and body role.

content_islands.name: Legal qualification
content_islands.spec: Keep the example-clearance note below the samples.

ingredient.name: Regional type alternatives
ingredient.role: Carry the hierarchy and character into unsupported writing systems.
ingredient.application: Contact the local agency for a similar-style alternative when Flame does not support the language; obtain Global Brand Management and Legal approval before release.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. The Chinese fonts are examples, not a universal substitute for every language. Printed examples require BK legal trademark clearance and local legal review before use.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text asks for an alternative in a similar style when the country’s language is unsupported.
reference_purposes.Expression: The Chinese examples show three distinct levels of typographic emphasis.
reference_purposes.Application: The page names example headline, subhead and body alternatives.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Proposed font use requires BKC Global Brand Management and Legal approval before release, plus applicable local compliance.
